attr.title: Pocket Tracker Extreme
attr.desc: Pocket Tracker Extreme 0.2.0-beta.3: native TrimUI Brick/KNULLI music studio with project swing, internal post-FX resampling, categorized effect/master libraries, expanded synthesis and 40 designs. Direct iPhone USB recording failed in current user tests; class-compliant interfaces remain separately untested.
attr.inst: New installs: extract the full ZIP into roms/ports. Existing installs: use the verified Program-Factory-Update kit to preserve launcher, helpers, settings, controls and all user data. Factory additions copy only missing presets. No PortMaster startup dependency.
